title: Login page returns 500 after password reset
body: After resetting my password through the email link, submitting the login form returns an HTTP 500 error. Logging in with the old password also fails.

title: Dark mode: text unreadable in task detail panel
body: In dark mode the description text in the task detail side panel is dark grey on a dark background.

title: CLI `tl sync` hangs when the server is unreachable
body: Running tl sync while the server is down blocks forever instead of timing out. Ctrl+C is required.

title: Recurring tasks are created twice at daylight saving change
body: A daily recurring task produced two instances on the night the clocks changed.

title: CSV export drops tasks with commas in the title
body: Tasks whose title contains a comma are missing from the exported CSV file because the field is not quoted.

title: Support sub-tasks nested more than three levels deep
body: Feature request: allow deeper nesting of sub-tasks for large projects.

title: Webhook delivery retries forever when the endpoint returns 410
body: A webhook pointing to a removed endpoint (HTTP 410 Gone) is retried indefinitely and fills the queue.

title: REST API pagination cursor breaks when sorting by due date
body: Using the cursor from the previous page together with sort=due_date returns duplicated or missing tasks.

title: Memory usage grows steadily in the notifications worker
body: The notifications worker process memory increases by about 50 MB per day until the container is restarted.

title: Add keyboard shortcuts for completing a task
body: It would be nice to complete the selected task with a keyboard shortcut.

title: Calendar view shows tasks on the wrong day for UTC+13 timezones
body: For users in New Zealand daylight time tasks due late in the evening show up on the previous day.

title: GitHub OAuth login fails with state mismatch error
body: Signing in with GitHub redirects back with an error: OAuth state mismatch. Happens in every browser.

title: Attachment upload fails for files larger than 10 MB
body: Uploading a PDF of 12 MB fails with a generic error. Smaller files work fine.

title: Docker container exits when DATABASE_URL contains special characters
body: If the database password contains characters such as @ or #, the container exits immediately with a parse error.

title: Drag and drop reordering resets after page refresh
body: Reordering tasks by drag and drop looks fine but the previous order comes back after refreshing.

title: Email reminders are sent in the server timezone instead of the user timezone
body: Reminder emails go out at the configured hour of the server, not the hour in the user profile timezone.

title: Search ignores accented characters
body: Searching for 'cafe' does not find a task titled 'Café menu' and the other way around.

title: Import from Trello loses labels
body: Cards imported from a Trello JSON export arrive without their labels.

title: How to configure SMTP with STARTTLS?
body: Question about the SMTP settings for a server that requires STARTTLS on port 587.

title: API rate limit headers are missing on 429 responses
body: 429 responses do not include Retry-After or X-RateLimit headers.
